description: Build a sourced map of an unfamiliar repository: entry points, modules, exports and how they connect.

inputs.name: objective
inputs.description: What the task must achieve, from the task record.

inputs.name: acceptanceCriteria
inputs.description: Conditions the result is checked against.

outputs.name: repositoryMap
outputs.description: One line per relevant module with path, exports and connections, each backed by a citation.

steps.description: Read the top-level layout, package manifests and README to learn languages, entry points and how the project is built and tested.
steps.evidence: Receipts for the files read and the layout observed.

steps.description: Search for the modules, symbols and configuration the objective touches. Prefer exact identifiers from the task over guesses.
steps.evidence: Search receipts with the matched paths.

steps.description: Read the call path between the entry point and the relevant code until each claim in the map is backed by a line you read.
Write the map where the task asks for it. Keep one line per module: path, what it exports, and how it connects.
steps.evidence: A file.apply_patch receipt for the map.
